opis: The cosy underground burrow from the reference picture (the same earthen walls with roots, the round woven rug, the wooden shelves with jars, the bed with a patchwork blanket, the lantern and the tunnel opening with earthen steps at the back), warm lantern light. Moving day is over: in the corner stands a SHORT FAT wooden BARREL with iron hoops; by the wall lie a few round firewood LOGS, one thick and one thin; a long thin wooden STICK leans against the bed; a box of crayons on the shelf. The MOLE stands in the middle on the rug, arms wide open, beaming; the FOX puts the last thick log down; the ROE DEER looks round with a happy smile. Cosy, warm and happy.
